change.title: pr-4
change.description: FEATURE: Embeddable Discourse comments, now with simple-rss instead of feedzirra
change.author: Robin Ward

findings.title: Imported feed HTML is stored and served unsanitized (stored XSS)
findings.body: Posts created here use cook_method raw_html, and Post#cook (app/models/post.rb:131-133) returns `raw` untouched, so no sanitizer runs. The content comes from an external RSS feed (poll_feed.rb:35, where `String#scrub` only fixes encoding, not HTML) and is rendered with `raw post.cooked` in embed/best.html.erb:19 and in normal topic views. Any `<script>` or `onerror=` in the feed runs on the forum's origin. `absolutize_urls` goes through Nokogiri and `to_html`, which does not strip scripts either. Sanitize the contents (for example with Sanitize, or the existing PrettyText sanitizer) before storing, or sanitize at render time for raw_html posts.

findings.title: URL interpolated into HTML unescaped, and `contents` mutated in place
findings.body: `url` only has to match /^https?:\/\// and can still contain `'` or `<`, so `#{url}` allows HTML and attribute injection. Use ERB::Util.html_escape. `contents <<` also mutates the caller's string, which raises on frozen strings and changes the caller's value. Use `contents = contents + ...`.

findings.title: `<%- end if %>` is malformed Ruby
findings.body: The first conditional should be closed with `<%- end %>`. `end if` turns into a modifier `if` whose condition is the next compiled statement, or a syntax error. Either way the view is wrong, and line 29 closes the second `if` separately.

findings.title: Origin check is a substring test
findings.body: `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` accepts any origin that is a substring of discourseUrl, such as a prefix, or an empty origin. Compare for equality against the origin of discourseUrl. Also guard against `comments` being null at line 5.

findings.title: `force: true` drops an existing table
findings.body: With `force: true`, create_table drops any existing topic_embeds table and its data. The same flag was added to the existing create_top_topics migration (20131223171005 line 3). Remove it unless an idempotent re-run is wanted. Also, topic_embeds has no index on topic_id or post_id.

findings.title: `--category` option removed from the Disqus import
findings.body: The `--category` option and its lookup were removed, so imports can no longer choose a category. `import_remote` is given no category option either. This is unrelated to embedding and is a silent behaviour change. Also, `import_remote` fetches each thread link over HTTP, which the old Permalink-only approach did not.

contracts.action: Embed best endpoint enqueues RetrieveTopic when no TopicEmbed exists and renders a loading page that reloads every 30s
contracts.before_after: The job runs TopicRetriever, which is throttled to one run per 60s per URL by Redis (lib/topic_retriever.rb:21-33). The loading page reloads after 30s, so the first reload may be throttled and the next one picks up the result.
contracts.visible_effect: The user sees 'Loading Discussion...' and then the comments after a reload.
contracts.failure_mode: If the import fails (no user, fetch error), the page reloads forever every 30s with no error shown. The job has no timeout on `open(url)`.

summary: The embed feature stores and serves feed HTML with no sanitization, which is a stored XSS on the forum origin and needs fixing before merge. The embed view also has a malformed `<%- end if %>` on line 6. Smaller items: the postMessage origin check, `force: true` on migrations, and the dropped Disqus `--category` option.
